generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civil engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

Banker Details Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025 percent of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- and Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder. The tender processing fee will not be refundable

Within 21 days of receipt of Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall Accept And Submit the Relevent Document to the employer In favour of the Executive Engineer, P.R.E. Division, K R Nagar, in accordance with the conditions of contract for Scheduled Tribe Category
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

As per Karnataka State Government order No. LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/ BMS/2007 Dated 27-7-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund. The tenderer shall abide by the directions of Government towards recovery as modified by the Government from time to time
All safety precautions, warnings, signs, deployment of security guards have to be ensured so that no un towards incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity

All materials required for the work, shall be procured by the tenderer himself and should be got tested by the Department quality control authorities at his own cost before use for the work. If employer wishes to engage third party inspecting agency for the said work, apart from the quality control authorities, then the contractor should cooperate with the third party for test

In the case of death of the contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates in the same terms and condition of the contractor of the work
The tenderers are requested to abide instructions and conditions 2 of 33 KPPP-Portal contained in the Standard Tender Documents K/W-1 and further orders thereon
The tenderer are Requested to Refer this NotificationFor More Information And fallow The condition
GST Shall be Paid Seperately
THE EE PRED DIVISION K R NAGARA Has Right To Reserve The Cancel or Accept Of Any Tender Without Any Giving Clarification
